description: Track a task with effort estimates and actuals

Do all work for this task in a branch called issue-XX

## Work and completion criteria

Describe the task and how to verify it is complete. Link related issues and requirements.

## Effort tracking

- Estimated time to complete (hours): Not yet recorded
- Estimator: Not yet recorded
- Actual time to complete (hours; coding + non-coding): Not yet recorded
- Coding effort (hours): Not yet recorded
- Non-coding effort (hours): Not yet recorded
- AI-assisted coding breakdown (hours; included in coding effort, not additional): prompt engineering, generation/post-processing, verification/debugging, integration/refactoring — Not yet recorded
- AI-assisted non-coding work (included in non-coding effort): Not yet recorded

After creating the issue, replace `XX` with its actual issue number. Add the estimate's basis as a comment and enter real values in the milestone project's E57B fields. Update actuals as work progresses; do not invent values or count the AI breakdown twice.
